title: [Illustrative] TREM2 agonism rescues dystrophy even without functional TREM2
statement: In TREM2 loss-of-function carriers, a TREM2 agonist reduces neuritic dystrophy relative to vehicle, although microglia without functional TREM2 cannot respond to TREM2 ligands.
mechanism: Combination of H-0001 and H-0002 by an evolution operator: keeps the dystrophy reduction and the receptor requirement, and moves both to loss-of-function carriers.
predictions: TREM2 loss-of-function, agonist: dystrophy decreases vs vehicle.

experiments.design: Amyloid-positive mouse model, TREM2-normal and TREM2 loss-of-function arms, early and late stage, agonist antibody vs vehicle.
experiments.readout: Neuritic dystrophy (LAMP1+ dystrophic neurites per plaque) relative to vehicle.

evidence.note: Illustrative demo hypothesis. No literature was consulted and none is claimed; the formal check never reads this field.

focus_area: Illustrative Stage 1 target: TREM2 agonism in amyloid pathology (CoResearcher OASE adapter demo)
